theory.heading: What AWS Solutions Architect Capstone is
theory.body: AWS Solutions Architect Capstone describes the methods and patterns used within AWS Solutions Architect to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.

theory.heading: Why AWS Solutions Architect Capstone matters
theory.body: Without AWS Solutions Architect Capstone, systems built with AWS Solutions Architect are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How AWS Solutions Architect Capstone works
theory.body: The mechanism behind AWS Solutions Architect Capstone follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of AWS Solutions Architect Capstone.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of AWS Solutions Architect Capstone
theory.body: AWS Solutions Architect Capstone offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
